mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id AS companyId, default_notice_days AS defaultNoticeDays, probation_notice_days AS probationNoticeDays, allow_resignation_withdrawal AS allowResignationWithdrawal, auto_deactivate_user AS autoDeactivateUser, require_manager_approval AS requireManagerApproval, require_it_clearance AS requireItClearance, require_finance_clearance AS requireFinanceClearance, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM separation_policies WHERE company_id = #{companyId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE separation_policies SET default_notice_days = #{defaultNoticeDays}, probation_notice_days = #{probationNoticeDays}, allow_resignation_withdrawal = #{allowResignationWithdrawal}, auto_deactivate_user = #{autoDeactivateUser}, require_manager_approval = #{requireManagerApproval}, require_it_clearance = #{requireItClearance}, require_finance_clearance = #{requireFinanceClearance}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO separation_cases ( company_id, employee_id, case_type, initiator_role, initiator_user_id, reason_category, reason_details, submission_date, requested_last_working_day, approved_last_working_day, notice_period_days, is_notice_waived, notice_shortfall_days, status, handover_notes, manager_approval_status, manager_remarks, manager_reviewed_at, manager_reviewed_by, hr_approval_status, hr_remarks, hr_reviewed_at, hr_reviewed_by, exit_interview_completed, exit_interview_notes ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{employeeId}, #{caseType}, #{initiatorRole}, #{initiatorUserId}, #{reasonCategory}, #{reasonDetails}, #{submissionDate}, #{requestedLastWorkingDay}, #{approvedLastWorkingDay}, #{noticePeriodDays}, #{isNoticeWaived}, #{noticeShortfallDays}, #{status}, #{handoverNotes}, #{managerApprovalStatus}, #{managerRemarks}, #{managerReviewedAt}, #{managerReviewedBy}, #{hrApprovalStatus}, #{hrRemarks}, #{hrReviewedAt}, #{hrReviewedBy}, #{exitInterviewCompleted}, #{exitInterviewNotes} )
mapper.update: UPDATE separation_cases SET approved_last_working_day = #{approvedLastWorkingDay}, is_notice_waived = #{isNoticeWaived}, notice_shortfall_days = #{noticeShortfallDays}, status = #{status}, handover_notes = #{handoverNotes}, manager_approval_status = #{managerApprovalStatus}, manager_remarks = #{managerRemarks}, manager_reviewed_at = #{managerReviewedAt}, manager_reviewed_by = #{managerReviewedBy}, hr_approval_status = #{hrApprovalStatus}, hr_remarks = #{hrRemarks}, hr_reviewed_at = #{hrReviewedAt}, hr_reviewed_by = #{hrReviewedBy}, exit_interview_completed = #{exitInterviewCompleted}, exit_interview_notes = #{exitInterviewNotes}, user_deactivated_at = #{userDeactivatedAt}, finalized_by = #{finalizedBy}, finalized_at = #{finalizedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: SELECT sc.id, sc.company_id AS companyId, sc.employee_id AS employeeId, sc.case_type AS caseType, sc.initiator_role AS initiatorRole, sc.initiator_user_id AS initiatorUserId, sc.reason_category AS reasonCategory, sc.reason_details AS reasonDetails, sc.submission_date AS submissionDate, sc.requested_last_working_day AS requestedLastWorkingDay, sc.approved_last_working_day AS approvedLastWorkingDay, sc.notice_period_days AS noticePeriodDays, sc.is_notice_waived AS isNoticeWaived, sc.notice_shortfall_days AS noticeShortfallDays, sc.status, sc.handover_notes AS handoverNotes, sc.manager_approval_status AS managerApprovalStatus, sc.manager_remarks AS managerRemarks, sc.manager_reviewed_at AS managerReviewedAt, sc.manager_reviewed_by AS managerReviewedBy, sc.hr_approval_status AS hrApprovalStatus, sc.hr_remarks AS hrRemarks, sc.hr_reviewed_at AS hrReviewedAt, sc.hr_reviewed_by AS hrReviewedBy, sc.exit_interview_completed AS exitInterviewCompleted, sc.exit_interview_notes AS exitInterviewNotes, sc.user_deactivated_at AS userDeactivatedAt, sc.finalized_by AS finalizedBy, sc.finalized_at AS finalizedAt, sc.created_at AS createdAt, sc.updated_at AS updatedAt, e.employee_code AS employeeCode, e.first_name AS firstName, e.last_name AS lastName, e.work_email AS workEmail, d.name AS departmentName, des.title AS designationTitle, TRIM(CONCAT(mgr.first_name, ' ', mgr.last_name)) AS reportingManagerName FROM separation_cases sc JOIN employees e ON e.id = sc.employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN designations des ON des.id = e.designation_id LEFT JOIN employees mgr ON mgr.id = e.reporting_manager_id WHERE sc.id = #{id} AND sc.company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT sc.id, sc.company_id AS companyId, sc.employee_id AS employeeId, sc.case_type AS caseType, sc.initiator_role AS initiatorRole, sc.initiator_user_id AS initiatorUserId, sc.reason_category AS reasonCategory, sc.reason_details AS reasonDetails, sc.submission_date AS submissionDate, sc.requested_last_working_day AS requestedLastWorkingDay, sc.approved_last_working_day AS approvedLastWorkingDay, sc.notice_period_days AS noticePeriodDays, sc.is_notice_waived AS isNoticeWaived, sc.notice_shortfall_days AS noticeShortfallDays, sc.status, sc.handover_notes AS handoverNotes, sc.manager_approval_status AS managerApprovalStatus, sc.manager_remarks AS managerRemarks, sc.manager_reviewed_at AS managerReviewedAt, sc.manager_reviewed_by AS managerReviewedBy, sc.hr_approval_status AS hrApprovalStatus, sc.hr_remarks AS hrRemarks, sc.hr_reviewed_at AS hrReviewedAt, sc.hr_reviewed_by AS hrReviewedBy, sc.exit_interview_completed AS exitInterviewCompleted, sc.exit_interview_notes AS exitInterviewNotes, sc.user_deactivated_at AS userDeactivatedAt, sc.finalized_by AS finalizedBy, sc.finalized_at AS finalizedAt, sc.created_at AS createdAt, sc.updated_at AS updatedAt, e.employee_code AS employeeCode, e.first_name AS firstName, e.last_name AS lastName, e.work_email AS workEmail, d.name AS departmentName, des.title AS designationTitle, TRIM(CONCAT(mgr.first_name, ' ', mgr.last_name)) AS reportingManagerName FROM separation_cases sc JOIN employees e ON e.id = sc.employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN designations des ON des.id = e.designation_id LEFT JOIN employees mgr ON mgr.id = e.reporting_manager_id WHERE sc.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND sc.company_id = #{companyId} AND sc.status NOT IN ('WITHDRAWN', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY sc.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ec.id, ec.separation_case_id AS separationCaseId, ec.company_id AS companyId, ec.department_type AS departmentType, ec.title, ec.description, ec.status, ec.cleared_by_user_id AS clearedByUserId, u.full_name AS clearedByUserName, ec.cleared_at AS clearedAt, ec.deduction_amount AS deductionAmount, ec.remarks, ec.created_at AS createdAt, ec.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM exit_clearances ec LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = ec.cleared_by_user_id WHERE ec.separation_case_id = #{separationCaseId} ORDER BY ec.id ASC

SELECT ec.id, ec.separation_case_id AS separationCaseId, ec.company_id AS companyId, ec.department_type AS departmentType, ec.title, ec.description, ec.status, ec.cleared_by_user_id AS clearedByUserId, u.full_name AS clearedByUserName, ec.cleared_at AS clearedAt, ec.deduction_amount AS deductionAmount, ec.remarks, ec.created_at AS createdAt, ec.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM exit_clearances ec LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = ec.cleared_by_user_id WHERE ec.id = #{id} AND ec.company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE exit_clearances SET status = #{status}, cleared_by_user_id = #{clearedByUserId}, cleared_at = #{clearedAt}, deduction_amount = #{deductionAmount}, remarks = #{remarks}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
UPDATE employees SET status = #{status}, exit_date = #{exitDate}, exit_reason = #{exitReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{employeeId} AND company_id = #{companyId}
